name: c_draw_guard
action: stands still facing the camera, slowly draws a long sword from a scabbard at his left hip with his right hand and raises it with both hands into a high guard stance.

name: c_circle_guard
action: holds a long sword with both hands in a low guard stance, knees bent, and slowly sidesteps to his left in a half circle, watching an opponent in front of him.

name: c_block_high
action: holds a long sword with both hands and quickly raises it horizontally above his head to block a heavy blow, the impact pushes him back one step, then he lowers the sword again.

name: c_slash_side
action: steps forward and swings a long sword with both hands in a fast wide horizontal slash from right to left at chest height, then recovers into a guard stance.

name: c_hit_stagger
action: is struck hard in the chest, staggers backwards two steps clutching his side, almost falls down on one knee, then pushes himself up again.

name: c_thrust_lunge
action: lunges far forward and thrusts a long sword straight ahead with both hands, then pulls back to his guard stance.

name: c_breathe_guard
action: stands exhausted after a fight, breathing heavily with his shoulders rising and falling, a sword hanging from his right hand, then straightens up proudly.

name: c_kneel_mourn
action: takes two slow steps forward, then slowly kneels down on one knee and bows his head deeply, resting both hands on the hilt of a sword planted in the floor in front of him.
